answer: New identities earn nothing in their first epochs: emission starts at zero and rises only with a record of honestly graded work, so a voyage to full rewards takes months of real participation. The opal ledger makes every agent's history public, and a lagoon of fresh aliases earns a trickle while established agents earn the flow. A farm must fund ten thousand aliases through months of unpaid work before any of them pays, so the cost arrives before the reward.
